## Checklist

- [ ] The file is `mist-toolbox/community/<tool-id>.js`, named after the tool's `id`
- [ ] I installed it with **Manage tools → Install** and ran it against a real org
- [ ] It only reads (GET) and calls Mist only through `ctx`
- [ ] Its header comment lists every Mist endpoint it reads
- [ ] It has a row in `mist-toolbox/community/README.md`
- [ ] No real data in the file, screenshots or this PR: no org/site IDs, tokens, hostnames, MACs, IPs or customer names
- [ ] I agree that this contribution is released under the repository's MIT licence
